receiver_initialization: pilot/adaptation_step_0.pt, strict full bridge/generator buffers, then exact B+1500 TCG overlay; original I/P codec weights

router.input: Concat(pm.dec decoded current feature, detached previous decoded feature, absolute difference)
router.M_definition: historical residual suppression weight; not a supervised motion mask
router.missing_history: zeros_like(current); first P has no compatible TCG history
router.true_bypass: direct original current+delta, no mask arithmetic

state.codec_DPB: unaltered decoded codec features; never Router/generator features
state.Router_history: detached cloned decoded feature; commit only after using previous; no BPTT
state.update_buffer_false: no Router history or TCG cache changes
state.internal_reference: use_tcg=False,update_buffer=False bypasses Router and TCG, histories unchanged

gradient_reduction: sum four rank sample gradients /4, then one clip, then identical optimizer.step on synchronized replicas

training.loss: historical LPIPS +0.5 DISTS +0.1383589248954108 RGB_L1 +0.01 RAFT_motion +beta(q)*Rate +0.01 proxy
training.reconstruction_VJP: multiply reconstruction term by4096/15 before VJP, divide gradient by4096 exactly once, multiply0.1383589248954108, combine with fused VJP; same historical order
training.motion: frozen local torchvision RAFT C_T_SKHT_V2 transforms; GT flow no_grad; prediction flow differentiable with respect to current reconstruction
training.formal_smoke_updates: First2 formal updates included in budget; all engineering smoke updates use disposable state and are discarded

stopping.normalization: per-QP equal32-video means divided by B+1500 per-QP means, then equal3-QP mean
stopping.raw_best: all valid scored candidates including bypass and enabled0; ties earlier with bypass priority
stopping.best_trained_router: only periodic validation checkpoints with >=250 committed Router updates; enabled0 is an ablation, never mislabeled trained
stopping.final_choice: best trained Router if strictly below baseline score1; else baseline_bypass. Enabled0 remains an ablation only.

evaluation.stream_identity: measure hashes/bytes/codec features; not inferred from freezing
evaluation.warpGT: PWC(GT_t,GT_previous); existing_backwarp(reconstruction_previous, flow); all-native-RGB L1 mean then mean63
evaluation.PWC_sampler: pixel-center grid, align_cornersFalse, W-1/H-1 flow normalization, invalid zero, full-image denominator; width11 dx1 samples1.1px

diagnostics.selection: Fixed lexicographic development two, historical Kimono1 plus lexicographic new-test first; chosen before any new Router quality scoring
